house.description: Definition of sexual orientation modified for purposes of the Minnesota Human Rights Act.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human rights; modifying the definition of sexual orientation for purposes of the Minnesota Human Rights Act; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 363A.03, subdivision 44.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 363A.03, subdivision 44, is amended to read:

Subd. 44.
Sexual orientation.
"Sexual orientation" means to whom someone is, or is perceived of as being, emotionally, physically, or sexually attracted to based on sex or gender identity. A person may be attracted to men, women, both, neither, or to people who are genderqueer, androgynous, or have other gender identities.[+ Sexual orientation does not include a physical or sexual attraction to children by an adult. +]
